# Review guidance

What to weigh when reviewing a change in this repository. Ordered by how often each bites.

- **Generated files.** `.github/workflows/ci.yaml`, `audit.yaml`, `deploy.yaml`, `release.yaml`,
  `.github/instructions/`, `.vscode/settings.json`, and `src/_shared/` are generated by dx syncs. A
  hand edit to one is drift — it must come from a template change in `qualithm/dx` instead. Reject
  it.
- **Tests with behavior.** Any behavior change should carry a test change. A feature PR with no test
  diff needs a reason.
- **Error messages.** Lowercase, no trailing punctuation, and still accurate after the change. An
  error that names a condition the code no longer checks is a bug.
- **Types and config.** When a data shape changes, the type definitions, env vars, and docs that
  mention it change in the same PR or the PR is incomplete.
- **Unused dependencies.** Removing code should prompt a dependency check — a dep nothing imports
  anymore comes out in the same PR.
- **No stale documentation.** A comment that narrates what code does ages into a lie; prefer its
  removal. JSDoc on exported APIs is the exception.
